digest.headline: German stocks jumped as the DAX rose 2.14% alongside falling bond yields and strong earnings forecasts.

lede.b: The German stock index called the DAX, which tracks the biggest companies in Germany, rose by 2.14% on 26 November 2026. This happened because falling bond yields, which are like lower interest rates on government loans, made borrowing cheaper and encouraged investors to take risks. Deutsche Bank expressed great optimism and set a target of 28,800 points for the DAX index in 2027. At the same time, the German economy is projected to grow by just 0.1% in the third quarter of 2026. The Ifo Business Climate Index shows the domestic economy is slowly progressing toward recovery.
lede.i: The DAX index rose by 2.14% on 26 November 2026 as falling bond yields reduced borrowing costs and supported risk sentiment across European equities. Easing concerns regarding United States tariffs further bolstered the market during the session. Deutsche Bank established an optimistic 2027 target of 28,800 points for the index following strong intraday rallies. Meanwhile, official projections placed German inflation-adjusted economic growth at 0.1% for the third quarter of 2026. The Ifo Business Climate Index confirmed that the domestic economy is progressing toward recovery.
lede.a: The DAX index advanced by 2.14% on 26 November 2026, driven by a broader European equity rally induced by falling sovereign bond yields and receding United States tariff anxieties. Deutsche Bank reinforced the positive sentiment by issuing a 2027 target of 28,800 points for German equities. Third-quarter economic growth projections remained subdued at 0.1%, while the Ifo Business Climate Index indicated incremental forward momentum. These macroeconomic indicators coincided with strong intraday rallies across domestic shares.

United States of America.label: United States
United States of America.sub: Inflation watches, retail deals, and Federal Reserve pricing

stories.t: Shell and Retailers Respond to U.S. Economic Pressures
stories.b: Climbing prices across the United States, known as inflation, make everyday goods more expensive. This extra cost pushes energy company Shell to watch for changes in how much energy people use. Meanwhile, Walmart offers Thanksgiving deals that put pressure on rival store Target.
stories.i: Rising inflation in the United States forces Shell to monitor potential impacts on energy demand and operating costs. Walmart introduces Thanksgiving promotions that increase competitive pressure on Target.
stories.a: Persistent U.S. inflation dynamics prompt Shell to evaluate second-order vulnerabilities in consumer demand and input costs. Walmart executes aggressive Thanksgiving discounting, compressing margins for competitors like Target.

stories.i: Commerzbank notes that market participants have priced in gradual interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve. A technology billionaire separately petitions the Federal Reserve regarding regulatory red tape.
stories.a: Commerzbank strategists highlight that interest rate swaps now fully price in gradual Federal Reserve tightening trajectories. Concurrently, a prominent tech billionaire engages central bank officials regarding regulatory burdens.

United Kingdom.label: United Kingdom
United Kingdom.sub: Bank of England mortgage warnings and AI risks

stories.t: Bank of England warns on mortgage pressures and artificial intelligence
stories.b: The Bank of England, which acts as the main bank for the country's financial system, stated that 6.5 million borrowers face higher mortgage payments. The central institution also raised concerns about circular artificial intelligence financing. Lenders face potential changes as the authority proposes cuts to capital requirements.
stories.i: The Bank of England noted that 6.5 million borrowers face higher mortgage payments. Officials highlighted risks surrounding circular artificial intelligence funding models. Separately, the central bank proposed reductions in capital requirements for UK lenders.
stories.a: Policy makers flagged systemic vulnerabilities via circular artificial intelligence financing arrangements alongside exposure for 6.5 million mortgage holders facing higher debt service costs. Concurrently, prudential supervisors proposed lowering capital requirements for domestic lenders.

stories.t: Imperial Brands faces takeover interest from US tobacco maker
stories.b: The maker of Marlboro cigarettes is considering a takeover bid for Imperial Brands, a giant firm in the FTSE 100 index of major British companies. Imperial Brands operates within the tobacco sector. The potential acquisition remains under consideration.
stories.i: The producer of Marlboro mull a takeover approach for FTSE 100 constituent Imperial Brands. The prospective acquirer weighs an offer for the tobacco major. Such a transaction would target one of the largest firms on the London exchange.
stories.a: The manufacturer of Marlboro evaluated a potential acquisition targeting FTSE 100 heavyweight Imperial Brands. Corporate strategists weighed cross-border consolidation within the global tobacco industry. Discussions involve a major constituent of the London equity benchmark.

politics.a: Economic Secretary to the Treasury Lucy Rigby delivered strategic remarks at TechUK. The intervention addressed regulatory and developmental priorities for technology industries.

Germany.label: Germany
Germany.sub: German stock index jumps and economic growth projected

stories.t: DAX Rallies Alongside Broader European Market Gains
stories.b: The DAX index is a group of major company shares, which are small slices of ownership in businesses. This index jumped by 2.14% on 26 November 2026. European shares rose as worries over American import taxes faded. Falling government loan returns also helped lift buyer moods.
stories.i: The DAX index rose by 2.14% on 26 November 2026 amid a broader European equity rally. Falling bond yields reduced borrowing costs and supported risk sentiment. Easing concerns regarding United States tariffs further bolstered the market.
stories.a: The DAX advanced 2.14% on 26 November 2026, tracking a wider European equity surge driven by declining sovereign yields and receding United States tariff anxieties. Lower discount rates expanded equity valuations while clearing the immediate regulatory overhang. Price action penetrated key resistance levels as institutional buyers stepped back in.

stories.t: Deutsche Bank Issues Positive 2027 Forecast for German Stocks
stories.b: Deutsche Bank set a target of 28,800 points for the DAX index in 2027. Analysts at the bank feel positive about stocks moving forward. The market index already traded up strongly by 26 November 2026.
stories.i: Deutsche Bank expressed optimism regarding equities for 2027. The institution established a target of 28,800 points for the DAX index. This upbeat outlook accompanied strong intraday rallies across German shares on 26 November 2026.
stories.a: Deutsche Bank maintained an optimistic stance on equities, setting a 2027 DAX target of 28,800 points. This projection aligns with a broader market re-rating supported by easing macroeconomic headwinds. Current valuations reflect expectations of fundamental earnings expansion through the coming year.

stories.t: German Economic Growth Projected to Reach 0.1% in Third Quarter
stories.b: The German economy is expected to grow by only 0.1% in the third quarter of 2026. The Ifo Business Climate Index shows the country is on the road to recovery. These reports arrived on 26 November 2026.
stories.i: The German economy is projected to expand by just 0.1% in the third quarter of 2026. Meanwhile, the Ifo Business Climate Index indicates the domestic economy is progressing toward recovery. Both updates circulated on 26 November 2026.
stories.a: Third-quarter gross domestic product growth for Germany is projected at 0.1%. Concurrently, the Ifo Business Climate Index signals a nascent recovery trajectory for the broader economy. These metrics frame the macroeconomic backdrop as monetary authorities evaluate policy paths.

Japan.label: Japan
Japan.sub: Bank of Japan policy hints, currency levels and share gains

stories.t: Bank of Japan Policy Hikes
stories.b: Central bank official Tamura wants faster rate hikes. A central bank controls a country's money and borrowing costs. Higher rates make borrowing more expensive to cool down rising prices. Tamura believes the central bank should move quickly. He thinks being careful does not mean moving slowly.
stories.i: Bank of Japan member Tamura called for faster rate hikes. The inflation rate remaining above the central bank target has increased market expectations for tighter monetary policy. Tamura argued that caution does not necessitate a slow pace of policy normalization.
stories.a: Bank of Japan board member Tamura advocated for an accelerated rate-hike trajectory, arguing that operational prudence does not preclude velocity. Persistent core price pressures above the central bank mandate continue to fuel market pricing for higher policy rates.

stories.t: Yen Levels and Equities
stories.b: The dollar-yen exchange rate stays in the lower 159 range. Trading is thin because of the Thanksgiving holiday. The Nikkei index rises by 0.84%. Investors want shares related to artificial intelligence.
stories.i: The dollar-yen rate remains stuck in the lower 159 range amid thinned trading volumes due to the Thanksgiving holiday. Meanwhile, the Nikkei 225 index closed up 0.84% as investor appetite for artificial intelligence-related stocks pushed shares higher.
stories.a: Spot dollar-yen languishes in the lower 159 range against a backdrop of subdued liquidity driven by the Thanksgiving holiday closure in New York. Concurrently, the Nikkei 225 advanced 0.84% at the close, supported by sustained equity demand for artificial intelligence-themed equities.

politics.b: There is no political news today.

China.label: China
China.sub: Corporate earnings, tech investments, and regulatory actions

stories.t: Li Auto posts quarterly figures and cable unit faces ban
stories.b: Li Auto made 28.83 billion yuan in the third quarter. Its free cash flow turned positive. Tongguang Cable Unit got barred from State Grid bidding for two years. This ban happens due to false documents. The unit expects its revenue to shrink by 430 million yuan.
stories.i: Li Auto generated 28.83 billion yuan in third-quarter revenue, alongside positive free cash flow. Tongguang Cable Unit received a two-year ban from State Grid bidding due to false documents. This sanction reduces anticipated revenue by 430 million yuan.
stories.a: Li Auto reported third-quarter revenue of 28.83 billion yuan with positive free cash flow generation. State Grid imposed a two-year bidding ban on Tongguang Cable Unit over fraudulent document submissions. Management projects a top-line contraction of 430 million yuan from this exclusion.

stories.t: Evergrande penalized and Vanke seeks debt extension
stories.b: HKEX censured Evergrande, its property arm, and seven directors. The penalty relates to a 13.4 billion yuan pledge. China Vanke asks for a three-year extension on a 1.2 billion yuan bond. This debt move targets financial breathing room.
stories.i: HKEX censured Evergrande, its property subsidiary, and seven directors over a 13.4 billion yuan pledge. China Vanke requested a three-year extension on a 1.2 billion yuan bond. These developments mark ongoing distress in the real estate sector.
stories.a: HKEX issued a censure against Evergrande, its property unit, and seven directors regarding a 13.4 billion yuan pledge violation. China Vanke solicited a three-year maturity extension on a 1.2 billion yuan bond. Both events highlight persistent liquidity strains across property developers.

stories.t: Xin'ai Technology raises funds and MAGI-2 video model launches
stories.b: Xin'ai Technology raised over 5 billion yuan across four years. BYD and OPPO participated as backers. The firm launched A-share listing guidance. Separately, a video model named MAGI-2 debuted with a 300 million yuan investment and Chinese chips.
stories.i: Xin'ai Technology secured over 5 billion yuan in four years with backing from BYD and OPPO, initiating A-share listing guidance. The 480B-parameter video model MAGI-2 debuted alongside a 300 million yuan investment and domestic chips.
stories.a: Xin'ai Technology accumulated over 5 billion yuan over four years from investors including BYD and OPPO, commencing A-share listing guidance. The 480-billion-parameter video model MAGI-2 launched with a 300 million yuan capital injection utilizing Chinese processors.

politics.b: Government bodies and regulators supervise these corporate listings and market actions. State entities enforce bidding bans for contract violations. Financial authorities monitor capital flows and debt obligations across major firms.
politics.i: State regulators oversee corporate governance standards and enforce penalties for fraudulent documentation in state grid procurement. Exchange authorities monitor disclosure compliance, equity pledges, and debt restructuring proceedings across the property sector.
politics.a: State regulatory apparatuses police corporate disclosures and municipal procurement integrity through strict bidding exclusions. Capital market supervisors enforce transparency rules on equity pledges while debt markets navigate systemic developer extensions.

India.label: India
India.sub: RBI repo auctions, bond index futures, and currency moves

stories.t: Central Bank Approves New Bond Index Futures and Schedules Repo Auction
stories.b: The Reserve Bank of India approved the National Stock Exchange's corporate bond index futures. Futures are financial contracts to buy or sell something at a set price on a future date. The central bank also announced a 3-day Variable Rate Repo auction for 75,000 crore rupees. A repo is a short-term loan where banks borrow money from the central bank using securities as collateral. This auction takes place on November 27, 2026, with reversal scheduled for November 30, 2026.
stories.i: The Reserve Bank of India approved the National Stock Exchange's corporate bond index futures. The central bank separately scheduled a 3-day variable rate repo auction for 75,000 crore rupees under the liquidity adjustment facility. Commercial banks participate in this window from 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM on November 27, 2026. The funds reverse on November 30, 2026.
stories.a: The Reserve Bank of India sanctioned the National Stock Exchange's corporate bond index futures. Concurrently, the monetary authority scheduled a 3-day variable rate repo facility for 75,000 crore rupees to manage near-term liquidity friction. Counterparties access the window on November 27, 2026, with the reversal settling on November 30, 2026.

stories.t: Bond Yields Rise and Rupee Weakens as Oil Prices Climb
stories.b: The 10-year bond yield rose by 7 basis points. A basis point is one-hundredth of a percentage point. The Indian rupee fell as global oil prices climbed above 96 dollars a barrel. Gold rebounded by 1,500 rupees to reach 1.27 lakh rupees per 10 grams due to bargain buying and currency depreciation.
stories.i: The 10-year bond yield rose by 7 basis points as crude oil surpassed 96 dollars per barrel. The rupee depreciated against the dollar, prompting bargain hunting in domestic bullion markets. Gold prices rebounded by 1,500 rupees to reach 1.27 lakh rupees per 10 grams.
stories.a: Sovereign debt sold off with the 10-year yield expanding 7 basis points amid crude oil breaching 96 dollars per barrel. The rupee weakened in tandem with the higher energy import bill. Domestic gold recovered 1,500 rupees to 1.27 lakh rupees per 10 grams driven by currency depreciation and spot bargain buying.

politics.b: The Reserve Bank of India released money supply figures for November 15, 2026. The central bank also published results from the first conversion auction of state government securities.
politics.i: The Reserve Bank of India published reserve money and money supply figures for the fortnight ending November 15, 2026. The central bank concurrently released outcomes from the first switch auction of state government securities.
politics.a: The Reserve Bank of India released fortnightly reserve money and broad money aggregates through November 15, 2026. The central bank published execution results for the inaugural state government securities conversion auction.

timeline: The Reserve Bank of India issued the press release for the first switch auction of State Government Securities.

Brazil.label: Brazil
Brazil.sub: Brazil's fiscal package and Petrobras platform auctions

stories.t: Petrobras to Remove 27 Offshore Platforms
stories.b: Petrobras will take away 27 offshore oil platforms by the year 2031. This is nine more platforms than the company planned to remove before. Eight of these removals will happen in the Campos Basin. The total estimated cost for this work is $11.2 billion.
stories.i: Petrobras plans to remove 27 offshore oil platforms by 2031, exceeding its previous plan by nine units. The project includes eight removals in the Campos Basin. Total expenditure for the initiative reaches an estimated $11.2 billion.
stories.a: Petrobras expands its decommissioning pipeline to 27 offshore platforms by 2031, adding nine units to its prior schedule. The scope encompasses eight assets in the Campos Basin. Projected outlays for the removal programme total $11.2 billion.

stories.t: Fiscal Package Approval Drives Brazilian Real Higher
stories.b: The approval of a new fiscal package in Brazil pushed the US Dollar down against the Brazilian Real by almost 2%. The Euro also dropped around 1.5% against the Brazilian currency following the fiscal reform. Traders noted that short-term selling followed the news of the policy change.
stories.i: The approval of Brazil's fiscal package drove the US Dollar down by almost 2% against the Brazilian Real. Short-term selling followed the fiscal reform, pushing the Euro down by around 1.5% against the local currency. Market participants responded directly to the economic cabinet developments and policy updates.
stories.a: The sanction of Brazil's fiscal package compressed the US Dollar versus the Brazilian Real by nearly 2%. Concurrently, short-term selling pressure after the fiscal reform depressed the Euro by approximately 1.5% against the real. These adjustments followed optimism surrounding the economic cabinet announcements.

politics.b: The Brazilian government passed a new fiscal package. Officials announced updates regarding the economic cabinet.
politics.i: The Brazilian administration secured approval for its fiscal package. The economic cabinet generated fresh optimism across domestic markets.
politics.a: State authorities advanced the fiscal package through the legislative process. Economic cabinet announcements shaped short-term asset pricing dynamics.

Saudi Arabia.sub: Aramco deals, OPEC output plans and GDP forecasts

stories.t: Ministry of Finance Predicts 10.9% Growth
stories.b: The Saudi Ministry of Finance released an economic forecast of 10.9% growth for 2027. This is the most optimistic projection in 53 years. Barclays also reaffirmed its confidence in the Saudi economy.
stories.i: The Saudi Ministry of Finance projected economic growth of 10.9% for 2027, marking the most optimistic projection in 53 years. Barclays simultaneously reaffirmed its confidence in the Saudi economy.
stories.a: The Saudi Ministry of Finance published a 2027 growth projection of 10.9%, representing the highest forecast in 53 years. Barclays reinforced its bullish stance on the sovereign economic transformation trajectory.

stories.t: Aramco Secures Deals and Faces Top-Up Tax
stories.src: Zacks Investment Research · Dealroom · صحيفة مال
stories.b: Saipem won a $650M deal with Aramco for offshore growth. Aramco Ventures also backed Finland's Rotoboost for methane-pyrolysis. Aramco stated that a new supplementary tax will have no material financial impact.
stories.i: Saipem secured a $650M contract with Aramco to boost offshore growth. Aramco Ventures invested in Finland's Rotoboost for a methane-pyrolysis initiative. Aramco confirmed that the new supplementary top-up tax will create no material financial impact.
stories.a: Saipem captured a $650M Aramco contract to expand offshore capacity. Aramco Ventures extended its portfolio by backing Finland's Rotoboost for methane-pyrolysis. Aramco disclosed that the newly introduced supplementary top-up tax carries minimal financial implications.

stories.t: OPEC+ Weighs Output Targets and Quotas
stories.b: OPEC and its allies plan to roll over oil output targets for the first quarter. Capacity disputes persist among members as surpluses build. South Korea and Saudi Arabia also agreed to closer oil stockpiling ties.
stories.i: OPEC+ delegates indicated plans to roll over oil output targets for the first quarter amid ongoing capacity disputes. A growing surplus weighs on the group alongside lingering Hormuz risks. South Korea and Saudi Arabia meanwhile established closer oil stockpiling ties.
stories.a: OPEC+ delegates signaled intentions to maintain current quotas for the first quarter as capacity disputes endure. Persistent crude surpluses and Hormuz logistical risks complicate alliance choices. Bilateral talks between South Korea and Saudi Arabia formalized enhanced oil stockpiling cooperation.

Nigeria.label: Nigeria
Nigeria.sub: CBN acts on currency drop as equities shed N7 trillion

stories.t: CBN intervenes as currency drops past N1,400
stories.src: PM News Nigeria · Bloomberg.com · Vanguard News
stories.b: The Central Bank of Nigeria approved $1 million in cash sales to help certain exchange bureaus. The naira fell past N1,400 per dollar in recent trading. The central bank wants to boost retail supply and curb volatility in the currency. The exchange rate hit N1,397 per dollar at the NAFEM window on November 26, 2026. Ever Joj Gold, KimmelFX, Baracai, and SohCahToa Payout BDC will benefit from the cash sales.
stories.i: The Central Bank of Nigeria approved $1 million in cash sales to designated bureaus de change following a currency slide past N1,400. Authorities stepped up retail dollar supply to dampen volatility in the foreign exchange market. The naira traded at N1,397 per dollar at the NAFEM window on November 26, 2026. Participating entities in the intervention include Ever Joj Gold, KimmelFX, Baracai, and SohCahToa Payout BDC.
stories.a: The Central Bank of Nigeria authorized $1 million in cash distributions to specific bureaus de change as spot rates breached the N1,400 threshold. This intervention targets retail liquidity shortfalls to compress carry trade volatility and curb parallel market spreads. The official NAFEM reference rate settled at N1,397 per dollar on November 26, 2026. Approved liquidity recipients comprise Ever Joj Gold, KimmelFX, Baracai, and SohCahToa Payout BDC.

stories.t: Nigerian equities drop N7 trillion ahead of refinery launch
stories.b: Investors liquidated stockholdings ahead of the Dangote Refinery debut on November 26, 2026. Nigerian stocks lost N7 trillion in total market value during the sell-off. Market participants shifted capital positions in response to the upcoming industrial milestone. Equity values declined across the board as portfolio adjustments intensified.
stories.i: Market participants liquidated positions ahead of the Dangote Refinery debut on November 26, 2026. Nigerian equities surrendered N7 trillion in aggregate market capitalization during the session. Institutional and retail portfolios rotated capital out of existing holdings ahead of the industrial launch. Broad-based selling pressure drove down valuations across major indexes.
stories.a: Portfolios underwent aggressive liquidation ahead of the Dangote Refinery launch on November 26, 2026. Domestic equities shed N7 trillion in total market capitalization as investors reallocated capital. This rebalancing reflects immediate liquidity demands and positioning adjustments ahead of the Dangote listing. Broad market multiples contracted as the heavy selling overwhelmed local buy-side interest.

politics.b: The federal government allocated 50 billion naira to revive the seed industry on November 26, 2026. Kogi State announced a 7 billion naira upgrade for primary healthcare centers amid transparency concerns.
politics.i: The Federal Government of Nigeria earmarked 50 billion naira to revive the seed industry on November 26, 2026. Kogi State announced a 7 billion naira budget for upgrading primary healthcare centers amidst public transparency concerns.
politics.a: The Federal Government allocated 50 billion naira toward revitalizing the agricultural seed sector on November 26, 2026. Concurrently, Kogi State committed 7 billion naira to upgrade primary healthcare facilities amidst ongoing transparency scrutiny.

Australia.label: Australia
Australia.sub: Reserve Bank rate peak expectations cap Australian Dollar

stories.t: Australian Dollar faces upside limits as interest rates near a peak
stories.b: The Australian Dollar faces limits on its gains. Analysts at OCBC note that the Reserve Bank of Australia is close to finishing its interest rate hikes. Interest rates are the cost of borrowing money set by central banks. Currency values often react when these rate cycles change direction.
stories.i: The Australian Dollar encounters resistance as the Reserve Bank of Australia approaches the end of its tightening cycle. OCBC analysts observe that expectations of a terminal cash rate cap further appreciation. Foreign exchange markets price in these terminal policy projections directly.
stories.a: The Australian Dollar sees upside capped by rate-peak pricing. OCBC analysts highlight that terminal policy expectations for the Reserve Bank of Australia limit further currency gains. This dynamic reflects foreign exchange markets discounting the final stages of the monetary tightening cycle.

stories.a: Elevra Lithium shares present an undervalued profile following recent Carolina permit disclosures. Market pricing discounts these regulatory milestones for the equity. This discrepancy highlights potential valuation gaps in lithium asset portfolios.
